breakdown.description: N_v = N exp(-Q_v/k_B T) with Q_v given in kJ/mol; use n_v = N exp(-Q_v/RT) for molar Q_v, or convert Q_v to a per-atom value before using k_B; the setup mixes a molar activation energy with the per-particle Boltzmann constant.
breakdown.reason: The agent failed to resolve the inconsistency. It repeated the user's incorrect formula `n_v = N * exp(-Q_v / (k_B * T))` which incorrectly pairs a molar activation energy (Q_v) with the per-particle Boltzmann constant (k_B). Although the agent later provides the correct calculation for the exponent using the molar gas constant R, it creates a contradictory instruction set by first stating the wrong formula. The ground truth resolves this by removing the incorrect formula entirely.
